claims.label: Private meeting with Erika and Justin Streiff lasted 4 hours 30 minutes
claims.claim: The host says her private meeting with Erika Kirk and Justin Streiff, with George present for the beginning and her cousin Mia sitting a little away, lasted 4 hours and 30 minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify meeting date, location, and stated duration against any third-party records.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Confirmed Possession of Charlie's Phone
claims.claim: The host says a viral clip from Erika Kirk's Glenn Beck interview had Erika saying she had Charlie Kirk's phone and that Charlie never texted anybody the night before saying he thought they were going to kill him, and that in the meeting Erika said she is looking at his iMessages and that he, like everybody else, communicates on Signal and Telegram.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Charlie Kirk's actual messaging platforms through device forensics.

claims.label: Erika confirmed Andrew Kolvet received pre-incident text
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk acknowledged in their meeting that Andrew Kolvet received a message from Charlie Kirk the night before, which the host says Kolvet told her was "they're going to kill me."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original message from Andrew Kolvet or his device records.

claims.label: Erika stated Dan Flood's pre-incident text specified "the left"
claims.claim: The host says that in their meeting Erika Kirk and Justin Streiff clarified that the message Dan Flood received from Charlie Kirk the night before said "the left is going to kill me," which she says she cannot confirm because she did not see the message.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Dan Flood message through his records or testimony.

claims.label: TPUSA case lawyer stated evidence base is at affidavit stage only
claims.claim: The host says a lawyer involved in the case, whom Turning Point USA called into the meeting, told her they have nothing beyond the affidavit and will not know what investigators have until the May probable cause hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the May probable cause hearing date through Utah court records; compare against public charging documents.

claims.label: Host Says Probable Cause Hearing Is Scheduled for May
claims.claim: The host says a lawyer involved in the case told her the probable cause hearing, at which evidence will first be presented to a judge, is scheduled for May (recorded as May 2026).
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm hearing date through Utah state court docket.

claims.label: Candace spoke with witness who filmed rooftop person at 12:23 pm
claims.claim: The host says she spoke with a witness who filmed a person on the roof at 12:23 p.m., and that he did not see that person take the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the witness and verify the video and timestamp.

claims.label: Host Says Rooftop-Filming Witness Described Smaller Gun, Black Tactical Gear, No Recoil
claims.claim: The host says the witness who filmed the figure on the rooftop told her he described the subject as wearing black tactical gear, carrying a smaller gun, and exhibiting no recoil.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify witness testimony through investigators and recorded statement.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy's first call was to wife Elizabeth McCoy
claims.claim: The host says the call logs Turning Point USA showed her indicate that Mikey McCoy's first post-shooting call was to his wife, Elizabeth McCoy, and that he stayed on the phone with her for 10 minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the call logs directly from Mikey McCoy or from phone carrier records.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey Three-Wayed Erika 3 Minutes After Shot and Father 2 Minutes Later
claims.claim: The host says, citing call logs shown to her, that Mikey McCoy added Erika to the call approximately 3 minutes after the shot and added his father Rob McCoy approximately 2 minutes later, remaining on the phone with his wife throughout.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the three-way call sequence against carrier records.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy's Real First Name Is Michael
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy's real first name is Michael and that "Mikey" is not a middle-name substitute, which she says Mikey wanted the audience to know.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against official identity records.

claims.label: Blake Neff's account contradicts the call logs
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff's interview account - that Mikey's first call after the shooting was to Erika and that Mikey then called his father - is contradicted by call logs Turning Point USA showed her.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Blake Neff's recorded statement against the verified call sequence.

claims.label: Elizabeth McCoy was removed from public narrative despite memorial/vacation visibility
claims.claim: The host says Elizabeth McCoy was left out of what was said publicly about Mikey McCoy's call log, although she was "main stage" at the memorial, is close with Erika Kirk and went on vacation with her, and says she does not understand this disappearing act.
claims.investigative_direction: Investigate the editorial decisions that excluded Elizabeth McCoy from circulated accounts.

claims.label: Three sources corroborated Bibi Netanyahu funding offer
claims.claim: The host says three different sources who would have knowledge of it confirmed to her that Bibi Netanyahu did make an offer to fund Turning Point USA to the next level.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the three sources and obtain documentary evidence of the offer.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet told Candace Bibi offered to take TPUSA to next level
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told her verbatim that Bibi Netanyahu offered to take Turning Point USA to the next level and that Charlie turned that money down.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Andrew Kolvet's specific statement; clarify whether this is the same person as Andrew Kolvet.

claims.label: Host Says Some of the Paid Campaigns Attacking Her Are Paid by PragerU
claims.claim: The host says she has the names of people in paid campaigns attacking her, that some are paid by PR firms and "too many" are paid by PragerU, and that she knows Marissa (N-335) there.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named paid accounts and any PragerU or PR-firm payment records the host says she holds.
claims.transcript_snippet: too many are being paid by PragerU, which is upsetting to me because I know Marissa, and it's just dirty.

claims.label: Rob McCoy does not work for TPUSA in any capacity
claims.claim: The host says she was surprised to learn that Rob McCoy does not work with Turning Point USA in any capacity, and that she had assumed he did because he called himself "America's pastor" at the memorial and his Wikipedia entry said he started Turning Point USA Faith.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Rob McCoy's formal affiliations independently of his self-presentation.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Defended Terryl Farnsworth's Camera Removal
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA echoed and defended Terryl Farnsworth's account that they were trying something new that day: they normally livestream tour-stop events but not outdoor "prove me wrong" events, and the new livestream required Terryl.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TPUSA's documented livestream policy and Farnsworth's specific authority on incident day.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet posted surgeon "man of steel" bullet description
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet posted a tweet saying he spoke with the surgeon, and reads a quote she calls allegedly from the surgeon: Charlie Kirk's bone was so healthy and dense that he was "like the man of steel" and the bullet should have gone through and through.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original tweet content and the surgeon's identity.

claims.label: Host Says They Did Not Know Kolvet Would Write the Surgeon Tweet
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet said he spoke to the surgeon, and that they confirmed Kolvet spoke to the surgeon but that they did not know he was going to write the tweet or that he had called up the surgeon.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kolvet's stated communication with the surgeon and HIPAA implications.

claims.label: Tim Pool previously said Candace has no security
claims.claim: Approximately one week prior, Tim Pool stated Candace Owens had no security beyond one guard and a 4-foot wall at a suburban residence.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the earlier Tim Pool statement against his show archive.

claims.label: Tim Pool now claims Candace uses same security as Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Tim Pool says Candace Owens has used the same security personnel and security companies as Charlie and Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the current claim against any documented security employment records.

claims.label: Candace used different security from the start via Shafer Security
claims.claim: Candace Owens retained separate security from Charlie Kirk's from the beginning; Charlie's initial security was Shaffer Security, operated by Greg Shaffer, employing Dan Flood and Brian Harpole.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Greg Shaffer's public statement and Shafer Security's documented client list.

claims.label: No cease and desist received from Charlie's security
claims.claim: Candace has received no cease and desist from Charlie Kirk's security apparatus over security-related claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm absence of legal correspondence through counsel records.

claims.label: New York Post alleged Candace threw car keys at Daily Wire producer
claims.claim: New York Post article reported an anonymous source claim that Candace threw her car keys at a Daily Wire producer in her first week.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the cited Daily Wire source and article publication date.

claims.label: Candace never drove her car to Daily Wire
claims.claim: Candace Owens states she never drove her car to the Daily Wire during her tenure; she had a driver.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Daily Wire security logs or contemporaneous records.

claims.label: Host Says Husband's Wikipedia Falsely Listed Qatari Citizenship
claims.claim: Per Candace, her husband's Wikipedia page was changed to say he had a Qatari passport or citizenship, which she says is made up; she says he has never been to Qatar and does not think he has ever flown over it.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify travel and passport records.

claims.label: Clip Cites Turkey Tom Video on Robinson Discord Messaging Style
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, a speaker addressing Viva Frei points to a video by Turkey Tom in which, he says, someone authenticated as having been in the Discord chats with Tyler Robinson and his partner, and who apparently spent time with them at the apartment, said "100%" this is how they talked.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Turkey Tom's claimed Discord membership through chat logs or other participants.

claims.label: George Zinn allegedly told nurses he was paid to pose as shooter
claims.claim: Per Candace, George Zinn, who was treated at Utah Valley, said he told the nurses that he was paid to do that.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through hospital records, nurse testimony, or police interview of Zin.

claims.label: Kash Patel allegedly angry at Gabbard and Kent over terrorist-angle probe
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, a speaker says that allegedly the rumors are that Kash Patel is getting mad at Tulsi Gabbard and Joe Kent for trying to look into a potential terrorist angle to the Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any on-record statements from the named individuals.

claims.label: Erika confirmed Charlie was attending mass and reportedly planning conversion
claims.claim: Answering a viewer's question about Charlie's journey to Catholicism, the host says Erika obviously confirmed it, that Charlie was going to mass, and that from what she has been told, which is third party, he was planning on signing up and starting that process.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through parish records and direct corroboration from Erika on the record.

claims.label: Hampton retreat involved Seth Dillon confronting Charlie over hypothetical anti-Netanyahu tweet
claims.claim: The host says Seth Dillon pressed Charlie Kirk at the Hampton retreat over a hypothetical tweet against Bibi Netanyahu, producing a heated moment.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any recording or attendee corroboration of the retreat.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Show Speaker Identifies Andrew Sypher as TPUSA Head of Field
claims.claim: In a clip from the Charlie Kirk Show that the host plays, a speaker identifies Andrew Sypher as TPUSA's head of field.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Andrew Sypher's official TPUSA title.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Show segment asserted August 27 had full location
claims.claim: In a clip from the Charlie Kirk Show that the host plays, a speaker says TPUSA had posted the UVU courtyard location on its website as early as August 27.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the specific August 27 post referenced.

claims.label: Candace identifies September 2 KAMYU as first public location mention
claims.claim: The host says the earliest mention of the UVU courtyard location that her team found was on September 2, when local media on KMYU said Charlie Kirk was speaking in the courtyard.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify KAMYU broadcast date and content.

claims.label: TPUSA/UVU/BYU August 27 graphic had no location details
claims.claim: Per Candace, the August 27 TPUSA/UVU/BYU chapter graphic announcing the event contained no location details.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original August 27 graphic.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk direct quotation on asking questions
claims.claim: Candace reads a direct Charlie Kirk quotation: "You better keep asking questions, because it's the only thing that keeps us free."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the quotation against the cited Charlie Kirk source.

claims.label: Host Cites Kanye West Tweet About Firing His Manager
claims.claim: The host says Kanye West tweeted years ago that he had just fired his manager because he realized he could not be managed, and that she identifies with it.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Kanye West tweet and its date; this is a personal analogy with no bearing on the case.
claims.transcript_snippet: when he tweeted a lot of years ago, "Just fired my manager because I realized I can't be managed."

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Side Told Her There Were No Rules and Any Question Was Allowed
claims.claim: The host says that in the 4 hour 30 minute meeting the TPUSA side told her she could ask any question on her mind, and that Justin Streiff and Erika Kirk were the TPUSA side present.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA to confirm the ground rules of the meeting; compare with any later statement by Streiff or Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: there were no rules. They said you can say you can ask us any question that you want, anything that's on your mind

claims.label: Host Says Streiff and Erika Were Most Upset About Her Godforsaken Company Tweet
claims.claim: The host says Justin Streiff opened by asking what the aim of the conversation was, and that he and Erika Kirk were most upset about her tweet calling TPUSA a godforsaken company that people should not give money to, which she concedes was aggressive.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the host's godforsaken company tweet and its date; ask TPUSA to confirm it was their main objection.
claims.transcript_snippet: they were sort of most upset with what I obviously a bit of a fever pitch, what I tweeted that it was a godforsaken company, and people should not give money to it.

claims.label: Host Says Alex Clark and Kolvet Podcast Interview Was Aimed at Her Without Naming Her
claims.claim: The host says that after her Catholicism remark in the tribute, Alex Clark and Andrew Kolvet gave a podcast interview that was clearly aimed at her, and that they teased it without ever saying her name.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Alex Clark and Kolvet interview and its promotional teases and check whether the host is named.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alex Clark and Andrew Kolvet then jump onto a podcast, and they're doing that weird interview, which is clearly aimed at me.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Told Her Erika Never Authorized Anyone to Call the Catholicism Claim a Lie
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA's answer in the meeting was that it was a crazy time, a new system had to be put in place, and Erika did not give any person the authority to say the Catholicism claim was a lie.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Erika Kirk or TPUSA to confirm on the record that no one was authorized to call the Catholicism account a lie.

claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA's historical announcement lead times for other outdoor events.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie sometimes throw the events out, you know, 7, 10 days in advance if something opened up in his schedule

claims.label: Clip Speaker Says Robinson Was Radicalized Around the Same Time as Crooks and Routh
claims.claim: A speaker in the Kirk Show clip, addressed as Viva, says that Tyler Robinson was radicalized at about the same time as Thomas Crooks and Ryan Routh, and near the time of the alleged January 6 pipe bomber, a politically useful period.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the speaker and compare the dates of the named individuals' alleged radicalization.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Robinson is getting radicalized right about the same time as Thomas Crooks, right about the same time as uh the other guy, Ryan Routh.

claims.label: Clip Speaker Theorizes George Zinn Was a Decoy Who Knew of the Plan
claims.claim: A speaker in the Kirk Show clip, addressed as Viva, offers a theory that George Zinn knew what was going to happen, showed up thinking he would be a useful decoy or distraction for Tyler Robinson, and may have been on the Discord chat.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask investigators whether Zin appears in any Discord records; the speaker says this is only a theory.
claims.transcript_snippet: He knows what's going down. He shows up there and thinks he's going to be some useful decoy or distraction for Tyler Robinson cuz they know what's going down.

claims.label: Host Says She Broke the Story That Zinn Told Utah Valley Nurses He Was Paid
claims.claim: The host says she broke the story that the nurses at Utah Valley, which treated George Zinn, were told by him that he was paid to do it, and that everyone is ignoring the things she broke.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the host's earlier episode with the nurse account and the source for it.
claims.transcript_snippet: I broke the story that the nurses were told at Utah Valley, which treated George Zinn.

claims.label: Host Says It May Be the First Time Kolvet Said the Robinson Messages Seemed Weird
claims.claim: The host says it might be the first time Andrew Kolvet has expressed that he thought the Robinson messages were weird initially, and that she welcomes TPUSA giving air to different perspectives.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who in the clip said the messages were weird at first and check Kolvet's earlier statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: that might even be the first time Andrew Kolvet has expressed that he thought that those messages were weird initially.

claims.label: Host Says Megyn Kelly Offered to Ref the Conversation Before the Bari Weiss Moment
claims.claim: The host says Megyn Kelly, who was initially going to ref the conversation when it was going to be livestreamed and before the Bari Weiss moment, offered to ref it.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Megyn Kelly's team to confirm her role in arranging the meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: Megyn Kelly, who was initially going to, when we were going to live stream the conversation, before the Bari Weiss moment, Megyn Kelly um offered to ref that conversation.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff Fumbled the First Invite
claims.claim: The host says her side had been trying to make the sit-down happen in the background since Blake Neff fumbled the first invite, and that public flak pushed TPUSA to fix it.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the first invitation from Neff and the host's reply.
claims.transcript_snippet: We were trying to make this happen in the background uh really since Blake Neff fumbled the first invite.

claims.label: Host Says Offers and Threats Were Made Over the Last Two Years and She Did Not Sell Out
claims.claim: The host says that if she were going to sell out it would have happened in the last 2 years, that offers and threats were made, and that she would not stop investigating for the highest bidder.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for specifics on the offers and threats; none are given in the episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: If I was going to sell out, it would have happened in the last 2 years, okay? Those offers were made, those threats were made.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Hands Were Not Charred When He Was Buried
claims.claim: The host says that Baron Coleman's electrocution video shows hands that look charred in the photos, but that she can say Charlie's hands were not charred when he was buried, on the word of a person she trusts.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source who saw the body at burial and compare with the autopsy and funeral-home accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: They do look charred in the photos that he showed, but I can tell you that his hands were not charred when he was buried.

claims.label: Host Says Coleman's Fort Huachuca Video Made Her Notice Things and Sparked Collaboration
claims.claim: The host says she watched a video by Baron Coleman building on her Fort Huachuca work, it made her notice some things, and they started researching other elements, which is why they plan to collaborate.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Coleman's video against the host's Fort Huachuca research.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had watched a video of his where he was building on Fort Huachuca, and he made me notice some things, then we started researching some other elements.

claims.label: Host Says Coleman Heavily Suggested JD Vance Could Have Been on the Base
claims.claim: The host says Baron Coleman suggested in his episode, which she wants to shut down, that it could have been Vance on the base.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch Coleman's episode to see exactly what he said about Vance.
claims.transcript_snippet: He kind of suggests in that episode, which I want to shut down, he suggests that I think he heavily suggests that it could have been the uh the V on that on the base uh Vance on the base

claims.label: Host Says Video of Vance Shows He Could Not Have Been at the Base
claims.claim: The host says she researched the Vance suggestion and found video of Vance, so it could not have been Vance on the base.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the video of Vance the host relied on and match its date and location to the Fort Huachuca dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's actually video of Vance, so it could not have been Vance in the base.

claims.label: Host Says Neff's Offer Was Not a True Offer and Erika Went Through Megyn Kelly
claims.claim: The host says the combined conversation was first meant to be live, that the offer Blake Neff made was not a true offer, and that Erika then communicated with Megyn Kelly and the host, with Kelly as intermediary.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Neff's offer and the communications between Erika Kirk, Kelly and the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: you saw the offer Blake Neff made, which was not a true offer, but then what came behind that was Erika communicating with Megyn Kelly and me.

claims.label: Host Says Streiff Proposed a Private Conversation to Lower the Temperature
claims.claim: The host says Justin Streiff said the temperature was a little hot and proposed a private rather than live conversation, which she says brought the temperature down, though she says she was always open to live-streaming.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Streiff to confirm who proposed taking the conversation off camera.
claims.transcript_snippet: What about we do like an off Not an off-record conversation, but have a private conversation.

claims.label: Host Says She Told TPUSA Things She Has Not Yet Said Publicly to Fact-Check
claims.claim: The host says that because the conversation was not live she was able to tell TPUSA things she had not yet said publicly so she could fact-check them, and that some relate to Charlie's research and 9/10.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch later episodes for the matters the host says she raised privately.
claims.transcript_snippet: I was then able to tell them some things that I have not yet said that I wanted to like fact-check and get some answers on

claims.label: Host Says Erika Said She Did Not See the Night-Before Messages and Feds Were Not Discussed
claims.claim: The host says they did not discuss whether the feds received the night-before messages, and that Erika said she did not see those messages.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Erika Kirk whether she or investigators have reviewed the messages on Charlie's devices.
claims.transcript_snippet: We didn't discuss whether the feds had received those messages. I will say that. We did not discuss that. But we did discuss She obviously said that she did not see those messages.

claims.label: Host Says She Saw and Spoke to No TPUSA Employees at Tucker's Christmas Party
claims.claim: The host says that, to her knowledge, she did not see or speak with any Turning Point USA employees at Tucker Carlson's Christmas party, which she attended because she has never had beef with Tucker or Marjorie Taylor Greene.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask attendees for a guest list; the host says the rumor is unsupported.
claims.transcript_snippet: To my knowledge, I did not see any Turning Point USA employees. I did not have a conversation with any Turning Point USA employees.

claims.label: Host Says She Had Catholicism Conversations With Charlie While He Was Attending Mass
claims.claim: The host says Erika confirmed it and that they know Charlie was going to mass, that she herself had those conversations with him while he was attending mass, and that his plan to start the process is third-party information she cannot confirm.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Erika Kirk or the parish about Charlie's attendance and any conversion steps.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can only speak on the fact that I wasn't lying. And that I was having those conversations with him while he was attending mass.

claims.label: Host Says Qatar Said It Worked With Hamas Because Israel and the US Asked It To
claims.claim: The host says Qatar recently said it works with Hamas because Israel and the United States asked it to act as intermediary, and that she tends to believe that.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Qatari statement and its date and speaker.
claims.transcript_snippet: Qatar recently came out and said, "Yeah, we work with Hamas because Israel and the United States asked us to.

claims.label: Host Says Jared Kushner Was Recently Allowed to Do Deals in Qatar
claims.claim: The host says Jared Kushner and Zionists are allowed to go to Qatar, which she says happened recently, and do deals, while she and Tucker are not.
claims.investigative_direction: Check reporting on Kushner's Qatar travel and deals.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't know why Jared Kushner and Zionists are allowed to go to Qatar, which happened recently, and do deals with them
